rationale: Locked BEFORE any training. rtBPD is the only external cohort, so a subject-level holdout is reserved from it. Subjects with BOTH sessions go to TRAIN (nf1) so their nf2 sessions provide a session-transfer test; subjects with only one session are reserved as the locked external test. Never edit this file.

feature_caches.note: DMNELF cache MUST come from the 19_fingerprint tree; the v1 efp_meirhasson tree has only 17 (no dmnelf002/003). Schemas verified identical: 31 ch, 10 bands, keys bp_tr/bp_hz4/ta_tr/tgt_tr/band_hz; time axis 125 TR (DMNELF) vs 150 TR (rtBPD).

locked_external_test.policy: Scored EXACTLY ONCE per arm. No iteration against it.

session_transfer_test.note: Same people as train, different session.
